08517 void HRTF::addResponse(Text const& key, const short* left, const short* right) throw()
08518 {
08519   static const float factor = 1.f / 32767.f;
08520   Buffer leftBuffer(FloatArray(ShortArray(128, (short*)left, false)) * factor);
08521   Buffer rightBuffer(FloatArray(ShortArray(128, (short*)right, false)) * factor);
08522   database.put(key, Buffer(leftBuffer, rightBuffer));
08523 }
08524 
08525 Buffer HRTF::getClosestResponse(const float azimuth, const float elevation) throw()
08526 {
08527   return getClosestResponseDegrees((int)(rad2deg(azimuth) + 0.5f), 
08528                    (int)(rad2deg(elevation) + 0.5f));
08529 }
08530 
08531 Buffer HRTF::getClosestResponseDegrees(const int azimuth, const int elevation) throw()
08532 {
08533   int elevationChecked = closestElevation(elevation);
08534   
08535   if(azimuth < 0)
08536   {   
08537     int azimuthChecked = closestAzimuth(elevation, -azimuth);
08538     const int size = 512;
08539     char buf[size];
08540     snprintf(buf, size, "H%de%03da", elevationChecked, azimuthChecked);
08541     
08542     Buffer temp = getInstance().database[buf];
08543     
08544     return Buffer(temp.getChannel(1), temp.getChannel(0));
08545   }
08546   else
08547   {
08548     int azimuthChecked = closestAzimuth(elevation, azimuth);
08549     const int size = 512;
08550     char buf[size];
08551     snprintf(buf, size, "H%de%03da", elevationChecked, azimuthChecked);
08552   
08553     return getInstance().database[buf];
08554   }
08555 }

08571 int HRTF::closestElevation(const int elevation) throw()
08572 {
08573   if(elevation <= -40) return -40;
08574   if(elevation >= 90) return 90;
08575   
08576   float rounding = (elevation < 0) ? -0.5f : 0.5f;
08577   
08578   float temp = (float)elevation * 0.1f;
08579   temp += rounding;
08580   int decade = (int)temp * 10;
08581   
08582   return decade;
08583 }

08587 {
08588   if(azimuth <= 0) return 0;
08589   if(azimuth >= 180) return 180;
08590   
08591   float temp = (float)azimuth / 30.f;
08592   temp += 0.5f;
08593   
08594   return (int)temp * 30;
08595 }

08630 static int ugen_HRTFclosestAzimuth29(const int azimuth) throw()
08631 {
08632   static const int choices[] = {
08633     0, 6, 13, 19, 26, 32, 39, 45, 51, 58, 64, 71, 77, 84, 90, 96, 
08634     103, 109, 116, 122, 129, 135, 141, 148, 154, 161, 167, 174, 180
08635   };
08636 
08637   if(azimuth <= 0) return 0;
08638   if(azimuth >= 180) return 180;
08639 
08640   int upper = 0;
08641   
08642   while(choices[upper] < azimuth) upper++;
08643   
08644   int lower = upper-1;
08645   
08646   if((azimuth - choices[lower]) < (choices[upper] - azimuth))
08647   {
08648     return choices[lower];
08649   }
08650   else
08651   {
08652     return choices[upper];
08653   }
08654 }

08678 int HRTF::closestAzimuth(const int elevation, const int azimuth) throw()
08679 {
08680   const int checkedElevation = closestElevation(elevation);
08681   
08682   switch(checkedElevation)
08683   {
08684     case -40: 
08685     case 40:
08686       return ugen_HRTFclosestAzimuth29(azimuth);
08687       
08688     case -30:
08689     case 30:
08690       return ugen_HRTFclosestAzimuth31(azimuth);
08691       
08692     case -20:
08693     case -10:
08694     case 0:
08695     case 10:
08696     case 20:
08697       return ugen_HRTFclosestAzimuth37(azimuth);
08698       
08699     case 50: return ugen_HRTFclosestAzimuth23(azimuth);
08700     case 60: return ugen_HRTFclosestAzimuth19(azimuth);
08701     case 70: return ugen_HRTFclosestAzimuth13(azimuth);
08702     case 80: return ugen_HRTFclosestAzimuth7(azimuth);
08703     case 90: return 0;
08704   }
08705   
08706   return 0;
08707 }
